description: List products in the merchant's catalogue. Answers 'what products do I have', 'find the Coca-Cola product', 'how much is X'. Pass categoryIds to answer 'what is in the Drinks category' — take the ids from get_categories, which does not return products itself. LIMITATION — there is no sorting: results come back in catalogue order and cannot be ordered by price, name or date. So 'the most expensive products' CANNOT be answered from this tool, and you must NOT page through the whole catalogue trying. Say plainly that sorting is not supported yet, then offer what does work: search by a name or SKU, filter by category, or ask the merchant to narrow it down.

categoryIds.description: Only products in these categories. Ids come from get_categories; a product matching any of them is returned

search.description: Filter by product name or SKU (partial match)
